name: @journal/desktop
description: JournalClaw Electron host — window + menu + daemon lifecycle only (zero business semantics).
author: JournalClaw

scripts.dev: bun run dev:clean && bun run build:daemon && bun run build:main && concurrently -k -n web,app "bun run --filter @journal/web dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:1420 && electron ."
scripts.start: bun run build:daemon && bun run build:main && electron .
scripts.build: bun run build:daemon && bun run build:main && electron-builder
